wireContract.wireLong: existing Yudao conditional JSON number/string Long serialization
wireContract.errorEnvelope: existing CUT CommonResult and controller-local HTTP mapping

exportChecklist.projection: all applicable rows from the same authorized checklist detail projection, including BUSINESS_SURVEY, RISK and DUAL_MACHINE_CHECK; no expanded visibility
exportChecklist.sideEffects: platform operation audit only; no persistent export artifact and no CUT business row insert/update/version touch

submitExtension.base: F-CUT-003 submit request, headers, idempotency, guards and ChecklistCommandResult
submitExtension.fieldType: NavigationDecision; never null after a successful checklist submit
submitExtension.businessResult: always the existing SUBMITTED checklist and PLAN_DRAFTING task before navigation is evaluated

configurationExtension.addedField: navigationRule in the existing complete configuration request and CutoverConfigurationRespVO
configurationExtension.create: POST /cutover-configurations/revisions keeps CommonResult<WireLong>; the existing complete create request adds required exact key navigationRule with NavigationRule OR JSON null
configurationExtension.saveDraft: PUT /cutover-configurations/revisions/{revisionId} keeps If-Match and CommonResult<Boolean>; the existing complete request adds required exact key navigationRule with NavigationRule OR JSON null
configurationExtension.detail: GET /cutover-configurations/revisions/{revisionId} keeps CommonResult<CutoverConfigurationRespVO>; response adds navigationRule with the stored NavigationRule OR JSON null
configurationExtension.copy: POST /cutover-configurations/revisions/{revisionId}/actions/copy keeps If-Match, no request body and CommonResult<WireLong>; copied value is verified by GET of the returned revisionId
configurationExtension.validate: keeps CommonResult<CutoverConfigurationValidationRespVO>; unknown target or any condition/list/priority/state field is reported at navigationRule or navigationRule.target
configurationExtension.publish: keeps If-Match and CommonResult<CutoverConfigurationRespVO>; response adds the unchanged stored navigationRule
configurationExtension.disable: keeps If-Match and CommonResult<CutoverConfigurationRespVO>; response adds the unchanged stored navigationRule

fields.configurationRevisionId: positive WireLong equal to the task-frozen revision

NavigationRule.semantics: one unconditional post-submit UI target; no condition, priority, list, state or action field

NavigationTarget.CURRENT_STAGE_WORKBENCH: navigate to the authoritative P4 workbench after submit
NavigationTarget.TASK_OVERVIEW: navigate to the cutover task overview

rowOrder: sortOrder ASC with null treated as 0

columns.type: text enum 是,否,已上传,已填写,empty; AuthorizedAnswerDisplay
text; authorized factDescription and business feedback; never raw snapshots or internal ids

sheetFilters.调研清单: applicable=true from the same authorized detail projection

AuthorizedChecklistWorkbook.cellSafety: all cells are text; never execute formulas

AuthorizedAnswerDisplay.DIRECT: existing boolean answers are 是/否; other nonempty answers are 已填写; only text and allowlisted business feedback are displayed, never structured raw ids
AuthorizedAnswerDisplay.MANUAL: authorized current evidence reference is 已上传 unless explicit business analysis supplies 是/否; missing reference never implies upload
AuthorizedAnswerDisplay.COLLECTION: only explicit business analysis supplies check result; technical completion or receipt alone remains empty
AuthorizedAnswerDisplay.EXTERNAL: empty check result; authorized factDescription only; never expose external raw response or identity
AuthorizedAnswerDisplay.conflictingBooleanChecks: 已填写 with separate labeled results; do not invent an aggregate pass/fail
AuthorizedAnswerDisplay.unknownSource: fail with EXPORT_PROJECTION_INVALID; never fall back to raw answerSnapshot
AuthorizedAnswerDisplay.emptyResult: empty check result and feedback cells

strictBoundary: unknown or extra request keys fail closed; export never falls back to another checklist version or unfiltered projection
